policy: Raw labelled reconstruction. Defaults frozen before looking at results; no optimisation or deployment.

rules.session_anchor: 09:30 America/New_York, US daylight saving accounted for, broker UTC 0
rules.days: Monday-Friday; no additional US equity holiday filter on these CFDs.
rules.displacement: Earliest consecutive bearish M5 leg of 1-3 completed candles within 09:30-10:30; total drop >=1.5x pre-leg ATR14, closing in bottom 25% of combined leg range.
rules.zone: Body of the last bullish candle in the six M5 candles before the leg, same NY day and not earlier than 09:00.
rules.zone_invalidation: Any later completed M5 close above the origin candle full high retires this first zone for the day; no replacement.
rules.retest: A later bearish M5 candle approaches from below, touches the zone with an upper wick, and closes below its lower body edge. Upper wick >= body and >=25% candle range.
rules.entry: Market short on first tick after rejection candle closes, until 15:55 ET; at most one successful trade per day.
rules.stop: Above max(origin full high, rejection high), plus 0.1x pre-leg ATR.
rules.target: Minimum completed M5 low from 09:30 up to the rejection close; locked at entry. Never future/final session low, and NOT fixed 3R.
rules.close: First available tick at or after 16:00 ET. No trailing or partials.
rules.risk: 0.5% closed current balance. Broker lot steps rounded down; undersized or invalid/margin-constrained trades skipped.

limitations: No original code/chart timeframe supplied; impulse, wick thresholds, zone bounds, cutoff, stop buffer and time exit are reconstruction assumptions.
The $50 gold fall is an example, not a transferable fixed threshold.
Pre-2026 broker ticks may be generated; inspect native quality and disclose.
A three-year screen is not untouched out-of-sample evidence.
